status: frozen before revision pilot outcomes; not a public preregistration
target: identity-target entanglement fidelity of a fixed deployed sequence
primary_loss: mean absolute error of final [0,1]-clipped point estimates
point_head: reproduce archived quantile-mean point predictor first; median is a separate declared sensitivity, not a silent substitution
identity_contribution: 1/d^2 is deterministic and consumes zero shots
measurement_scope: independent full-sequence executions with bath reset between executions; memory within a sequence is retained

data_policy.archived_4096_split: development/pilot only; it has already been inspected
data_policy.eta_distribution: continuous Uniform(0.85, 0.99), independent of observable parameters

fusion: empirical-Bayes residual shrinkage corrected for finite-label noise
fusion_fit: four-fold out-of-fold prior predictions on the 64 calibration examples; refit deployment prior on all 64; independent label and pilot outcomes
allocation: pilot variance allocation with all pilot shots counted; estimate from independent stage-two outcomes
oracle_policy: exact conditional variances and exact labels are diagnostic only, excluded from deployable estimator fits and allocation

statistical_analysis.pairing: same test queries and same measurement outcomes for methods sharing an allocation
statistical_analysis.resampling: crossed query and checkpoint indices; independent calibration-draw clusters; measurement repeats nested within draw. Resample each shared unit once for all compared methods
statistical_analysis.matched_accuracy_primary: validation-selected budgets at common MAE targets 0.065 and 0.053; independent test confirmation
statistical_analysis.noninferiority: upper one-sided 95% CI of hybrid MAE minus baseline MAE below 0.002; Holm adjustment for the two prespecified targets
statistical_analysis.equivalence_wording: only if both one-sided equivalence tests pass the prespecified +/-0.002 margin, with multiplicity handled
statistical_analysis.margin_rationale: explicit operational tolerance of 0.2 percentage points in fidelity MAE, not a physical threshold; also report exact differences and zero-margin superiority
statistical_analysis.budget_selection: choose from measured validation budgets; no test-driven budget or prior selection
statistical_analysis.unattained_target: report target not reached; do not extrapolate or select replacement targets from test results

costs.per_query: all nonidentity measurement shots, including allocation pilots
costs.offline: finite calibration labels plus fusion-fit measurements and any method-specific quantum calibration
costs.readout_rate: known in stress test; if estimated, characterization shots require a separate cost entry
costs.break_even: (offline_hybrid-offline_baseline)/(query_baseline-query_hybrid), only for validated accuracy and positive denominator

grid_audit.label: empirical span, a lower bound on the full fibre diameter
grid_audit.bayes: report distribution explicitly and do not identify discrete-grid risk with continuous-distribution risk

publication_gate: No old savings percentage or break-even count retained without corrected measurements and statistical support
